payload.title: The revised policy has not been adopted — still waiting
payload.summary: The 2026 revision is not in force and has not been adopted. On the timetable officers set out in March, the Licensing committee sees the consultation results in September 2026 and full council is asked to approve a final policy in November, so it can start on 1 December 2026. None of that has happened yet.
detail: Officers proposed taking the revised policy to full council in November 2026 for adoption by 1 December 2026.
Cabinet authorised the consultation on 11 March 2026. The policy itself has not been to full council, which is the meeting that adopts it.
A cumulative impact assessment was to run alongside the consultation. Nothing in the documents we hold shows that one has been published, and it is not on the consultation page.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 7 September 2026
